dct_creator_sm: Hamilton, Diana (Mount Alison University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3917-2566
dct_description_sm: These data were involved in our assessment of niche partitioning by shorebirds on the Northumberland Strait, New Brunswick, Canada. There are 3 separate .csv files - one contains data on foraging rates of the different species relative to multiple covariates, and was used for the PERMANOVA presented in the paper. Another contains data on shorebird species composition present inside and outside tide pools. The third contains carbon and nitrogen stable isotope data for shorebird blood plasma. Each file has an associated read me file explaining column headers. Data were collected between 17 June 2019 and 9 October 2019. Location: Petit Cap, New Brunswick: 46.19oN, -64.15oW and Cape Jourimain New Brunswick 46.15oN, -63.85oW
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Bellefontaine and Hamilton, 2023. Shorebirds exhibit niche partitioning on multiple dimensions at a small staging site on the Northumberland Strait, New Brunswick, Canada. Facets.
